atoms.a: The class earned £195.39 from the charity bake sale. How much money did they earn when the amount is rounded to the nearest one pound?
How about to the nearest ten pounds?
Bernie went running for one hour. According to her watch, she ran 10.509 kilometers. Rounded to the nearest one hundredth of a kilometer, how far did Bernie run?
And rounded to the nearest tenth of a kilometer?
How about rounded to the nearest one kilometer?
Harry the hippo drank 245.889 litres of water yesterday. How much water did Harry drink, rounded to the nearest tenth of a litre?
How about to the nearest one litre of water?
And to the nearest ten litres of water?
